definition: Required by law or rules; compulsory.
exampleSentence: Safety induction training is mandatory for all site visitors.

definition: Formally forbidden by law or rule.
exampleSentence: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the auditorium.
It is advisable to check the weather forecast before hillwalking.
Photography is permitted in the gallery without flash.

definition: To act in accordance with a wish or command.
exampleSentence: All candidates must comply with examination hall rules.

definition: Required by law or a rule; obligatory.
exampleSentence: Attendance at the laboratory safety workshop is strictly compulsory.

definition: Available to be chosen but not obligatory.
exampleSentence: Attending the evening discussion group remains entirely optional.

definition: A general rule, principle, or piece of advice.
exampleSentence: Review the formatting guidelines before submitting your final essay.

definition: A moral or legal obligation; a responsibility.
exampleSentence: It is the citizen's duty to respect public property.

definition: One of a set of explicit regulations or principles governing conduct.
exampleSentence: All competitors must abide by the international governing rules.
